office_does: A King County District Court judge hears misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders, and is elected by voters in the electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Matthew York is the only candidate for this position and is running as the incumbent.

candidates.summary: Incumbent King County District Court judge for nine years who has served as South Presiding Judge and Chief Presiding Judge, per his pamphlet statement.
highlights: Judge for the past nine years [S1]
Elected by colleagues as South Presiding Judge and Chief Presiding Judge [S1]
Has chaired the court's Executive and Rules Committees [S1]
